headline: Executive order creates a presidential council focused on the future of Princeville, North Carolina.
what_it_does: This order sets up a President's Council on the Future of Princeville, North Carolina. Based on the title alone, the council's job appears to be advising on issues facing the town and its future. No summary was provided, so details about the council's members, duties, and powers are not available here.

who_it_affects.how: Their town is the focus of a new presidential council meant to address its future.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 29, 2000; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
